jobs.description:
Software Engineer II (Backend / AWS) | Contract | Amsterdam, Netherlands

🚀 Join a large-scale cloud transformation programme that is redefining how millions of customer interactions are managed across voice, chat, email, and digital support channels.

We're looking for experienced Software Engineers
with strong AWS and backend engineering expertise to help deliver a modern, cloud-native customer service platform built on Amazon Connect
and AWS technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a highly visible programme involving large-scale distributed systems, complex integrations, and enterprise-grade software engineering.

Contract Details

12-month Independent Contractor contract

€105 per hour + VAT on top

40 hours per week

Hybrid working

2 days per week onsite in Amsterdam

Immediate start preferred

The Opportunity

You'll join an established engineering team working on a multi-year transformation programme that is consolidating multiple customer communication platforms into a single AWS-based ecosystem. The programme is already live in production and continues to expand across additional channels, languages, integrations, and business areas.

As a Software Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable cloud services while contributing to architectural decisions, system reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and develop backend applications and services
Build scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS
Develop event-driven and distributed systems
Own services end-to-end, including monitoring and production support
Participate in system design and architectural discussions
Resolve production issues and improve system reliability
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams
Drive code quality, automation, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives

Required Skills

✅ Strong AWS experience (essential)
✅ Java development experience
✅ AWS Lambda
✅ Amazon S3
✅ Event-driven architectures
✅ Distributed systems
✅ Cloud-native application development
✅ API and integration experience
✅ Strong software engineering and system design capability.

Nice to Have

Amazon Connect experience
Contact centre platform experience
Customer service technology experience
Large-scale enterprise transformation programme experience

What We're Looking For

Proven experience building and operating production systems
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
Experience working within agile engineering teams
Ability to contribute to technical discussions and design decisions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
A proactive approach to ownership and delivery

If you're an experienced AWS Software Engineer looking to work on a high-impact cloud transformation programme using modern technologies, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply now or contact us for more information.

jobs.title: Integration Specialist, Poland
jobs.description:
The Integration Specialist is responsible for designing, configuring, testing, and supporting customer integrations during the implementation lifecycle. This role serves as the technical bridge between customers, Implementation Managers, Product, and Engineering to ensure seamless connectivity between customer systems and the OneRail platform.

The ideal candidate is highly technical, customer-focused, and enjoys solving integration challenges while working in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

Customer Integrations

Design, configure, and implement customer integrations using APIs, webhooks, SFTP, EDI, and flat-file exchanges.
Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer system architecture and business workflows.
Configure integration mappings, authentication methods, and data transformations.
Validate end-to-end data flow prior to production launch.

Technical Delivery

Partner with Implementation Managers to develop technical implementation plans.
Build and execute integration test plans.
Troubleshoot API connectivity, data validation, and workflow issues.
Document technical configurations and implementation decisions.
Create extensive and detailed process and integration flows of customers' existing infrastructure and how it will connect to OneRail.
Ensure integrations meet security and performance requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the technical liaison between Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customers.
Escalate product defects and enhancement requests with clear technical documentation.
Collaborate with Engineering during complex implementations requiring custom development.
Assist Support with complex post-go-live integration issues when necessary.

Process Improvement

Develop reusable integration templates and documentation.
Improve implementation processes through automation and standardization.
Create internal knowledge base articles and customer-facing technical guides.
Identify opportunities to reduce implementation timelines through repeatable solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience implementing SaaS software or enterprise integrations.
Experience working with REST APIs.
Familiarity with JSON, XML, CSV, and data transformation.
SQL knowledge for data validation.
Understanding authentication methods such as OAuth and API Keys.
Experience with Postman or similar API testing tools.
Familiarity with middleware/iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, etc.).
Ability to manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Experience with logistics, transportation, supply chain, or retail technology.
Understanding webhooks and event-driven architecture.
Experience working in a customer-facing SaaS environment.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency in English & Polish, both written and spoken (B2+).

Work Location

Hybrid, Kraków, Poland

Office location:
Kraków, Poland

Work Style:
Hybrid (3-4 days from the office/week)

Salary levels:
13 000 – 16 000 PLN/month

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Fintech Platform (m/f/n)
jobs.description:
InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost is building the FinTech platform that powers payments for one of Europe's largest logistics and e-commerce ecosystems. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to become our organisation-wide technical authority - someone who can arbitrate architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer domains, and who has genuinely shipped AI-assisted engineering workflows in production, not just talked about them.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll work directly with the Head of FinTech Engineering and business leadership, translating critical business goals - new product lines, regulatory deadlines, growth targets - into architecture decisions and roadmap input. You'll be the final word on cross-domain technical questions that no single team or Staff Engineer can resolve alone.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the single cross-domain technical authority, arbitrating architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer platform areas
Partner directly with the Head of Engineering and business leadership to turn business strategy into technical roadmap input
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs for organisation-wide decisions, with reasoning accessible to both engineers and business stakeholders
Own the agentic engineering harness at an organisational level — design, instrument, and continuously improve AI-assisted engineering workflows based on real production data
Identify and drive the adoption or deprecation of patterns across all teams, building the case and sequencing change without direct authority
Mentor Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers on architecture craft, technical communication, and agentic tooling

Qualifications

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
5+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
3+ years of agentic/LLM engineering in production — shipped systems, not theoretical patterns
Deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture: event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern
Experience designing APIs at an organisational boundary level — REST, async, and event-based contracts
Strong grasp of database trade-offs (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure) at organisation scale
Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, context management, and evaluation harnesses for AI-assisted engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing for mixed audiences — ADRs and RFCs that work for engineers and business leadership alike
English proficiency at B2 or above
University degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

Nice to have:

3+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
PCI DSS / PSD2 architecture compliance experience from the design phase
BNPL or lending domain architecture experience
Open-source contributions or external technical publishing
Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform
Formal mentorship of Staff-level or EM-track engineers
Polish language skills

Additional Information

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
 InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and flexible hours
We offer B2B type of contract

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com 

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. 

Role Summary

This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.

As a Full-Stack Software Developer
, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)
– the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

Team Jaguar is responsible for the Software Update domain
, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular
in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and maintain full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable safe and reliable software updates of vehicles;
Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

You have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience
and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

You have experience with C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures
, combined with frontend development. Experience with Angular is preferred
, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only how
something should be built, but why it matters to the people using it
.

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.

This Is Us

Team Jaguar
is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite
.

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better
, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

We strive to work in an agile and iterative way
, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development
, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

As part of the wider TRATON Workshop Suite development organization
, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group   R&D.
